project.description: 刷新 cyt-common-deploy 的 BRANCH 下拉列表 = GitHub 当前分支。新建分支后点一下即可，零插件、不重启 Jenkins。

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail BOOTSTRAP=/opt/cyt-common/deploy/git-hub.sh WORK=/tmp/cyt-common-refresh-$$ trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
# 固定取 main 上的刷新脚本，保证刷新逻辑本身稳定，不受待发布分支影响 bash "$BOOTSTRAP" fetch main "$WORK" cd "$WORK" bash deploy/test-server/refresh-branches.sh main
